source: Requests built from the production Arms and Fury/Protection Warrior fixtures with an item swap set and rotation lines that swap; each Go golden is the pinned Go engine's DPS for every iteration (forever-go-oracle-v2 sim at a667dce8492bd9fb94269a9f864289cb74006775, 300 iterations, seed 42).
note: The Go exporter refuses an off hand swap, so these have no prepared golden: Rust prepares them under Rules::GoReference and must give Go's DPS for every iteration.

cases.description: Arms with Blackblade of Shahram swapping to Dal'Rend's Sacred Charge and Skullflame Shield from 30 to 60 seconds: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, the shield's stats and its Shield Wall condition follow the swap.
Arms swapping to Arcanite Reaper when Mortal Strike is 1.5 seconds from ready and back once it is on cooldown: Mortal Strike hits with the slower weapon in the hand.

Fury/Protection with Shield Block in the rotation and no tanking, swapping its shield and one-hander for Blackblade of Shahram from 30 to 60 seconds: Shield Block falls if it is up and cannot be cast without the shield.
